story.originalTitle: Lawson to replace Hadjar at Red Bull for Dutch GP
story.summaryEn: Red Bull has officially confirmed that Liam Lawson will replace the injured Isack Hadjar at this weekend's Formula 1 Dutch Grand Prix. Hadjar sustained a wrist injury during a gym session over the summer shutdown and will therefore miss the race at Zandvoort.
detailZh: 劳森将在红牛顶替哈贾尔出战荷兰大奖赛
哈贾尔因伤将缺席本周末的大奖赛
红牛已正式确认，利亚姆·劳森将在本周末的F1荷兰大奖赛中顶替受伤的伊萨克·哈贾尔。
周三上午有消息称，哈贾尔在健身房训练中手腕受伤，因此将缺席赞德沃特站，正式决定即将公布。
这意味着哈贾尔无法在这条迄今为止给他带来唯一一个F1领奖台的赛道上比赛——他在2025年令人印象深刻的新秀赛季中代表小红牛获得第三名。
红牛的一份声明写道：“红牛车队车手伊萨克·哈贾尔在夏季休赛期手腕受伤，将无法参加2026年荷兰大奖赛。”
“我们将迎回利亚姆·劳森，他本周末将驾驶小红牛22顶替出战。车队祝愿伊萨克早日康复，并感谢利亚姆在短时间内挺身而出。”
劳森现在将再次获得成为马克斯·维斯塔潘队友的机会，他曾在2025年前两站担任这一角色，随后被下放回小红牛。
但这位24岁的车手如今更加成熟，本赛季在红牛的姊妹车队表现出色，11站后劳森位列第九，今年迄今为止除三站外均获得积分。
这一消息也意味着劳森在红牛的继任者角田裕毅重返F1，角田去年在维斯塔潘身边表现严重挣扎后，在2026年车手阵容中失去了席位。
小红牛的一份声明写道：“由于伊萨克·哈贾尔手腕受伤，利亚姆·劳森本周末将代表红牛车队出战荷兰大奖赛。”
“由于此次车手变动，储备车手角田裕毅本周末将在赞德沃特代表小红牛出战，与阿尔维德·林德布拉德搭档。”
“我们感谢利亚姆和角田的适应能力，各车队正在为周末做准备，我们祝愿伊萨克早日康复。”
拥有111场大奖赛发车记录的角田，据悉正与Meyer Shank 比赛洽谈2027年的IndyCar席位。
detailEn: Lawson to replace Hadjar at Red Bull for Dutch GP
Hadjar has sustained an injury so will miss this weekend's grand prix
Red Bull has officially confirmed that Liam Lawson will replace the injured Isack Hadjar at this weekend’s Formula 1 Dutch Grand Prix.
News emerged on Wednesday morning that Hadjar had sustained a wrist injury from a gym session and was therefore set to skip Zandvoort, with a formal decision impending.
It means Hadjar is unable to compete at the track which has so far given him his only F1 podium, after taking third for Racing Bulls during his impressive rookie campaign in 2025.
A Red Bull statement read: "Red Bull Racing driver Isack Hadjar has sustained a wrist injury during summer shutdown that will prevent him from racing at the 2026 Dutch Grand Prix.
"We will be welcoming back Liam Lawson, who will replace him in RB22 this weekend. The team wishes Isack a speedy recovery and thanks Liam for stepping in on short notice."
Lawson will now receive the opportunity to once again be Max Verstappen’s team-mate, after doing so for the first two rounds of 2025 before being demoted back to Racing Bulls.
But the 24-year-old is now more mature and has impressed with Red Bull’s sister squad this season, as Lawson sits ninth after 11 rounds with points in all but three grands prix so far this year.
This news also means an F1 return for Lawson’s Red Bull successor Yuki Tsunoda, who was left without a seat on the 2026 grid after seriously struggling alongside Verstappen last year.
A Racing Bulls statement read: "Liam Lawson will race for Red Bull Racing at the Dutch Grand Prix this weekend due to Isack Hadjar's wrist injury.
"As a result of the driver change, reserve driver Yuki Tsunoda will race for Racing Bulls in Zandvoort this weekend, alongside Arvid Lindblad.
"We thank both Liam and Yuki for their adaptability as the teams prepare for the weekend and we wish Isack a speedy recovery."
Tsunoda, who has 111 grand prix starts, is understood to be in talks for an IndyCar drive at Meyer Shank Racing in 2027.
keyPointsZh: 哈贾尔在赞德沃特曾于2025年新秀赛季代表小红牛获得个人唯一一个F1领奖台（第三名）。
劳森曾在2025年前两站担任维斯塔潘的队友，后被下放回小红牛，本赛季11站后以第九名、除三站外均得分的成绩表现亮眼。
由于此次车手变动，红牛储备车手角田裕毅将在赞德沃特代表小红牛出战，与阿尔维德·林德布拉德搭档；角田据悉正与Meyer Shank 比赛洽谈2027年IndyCar席位。
keyPointsEn: Hadjar's only F1 podium came at Zandvoort, where he finished third for Racing Bulls during his impressive rookie campaign in 2025.

Lawson previously partnered Max Verstappen for the first two rounds of 2025 before being demoted back to Racing Bulls, and sits ninth after 11 rounds this season with points in all but three grands prix.

As a result of the driver change, Red Bull reserve driver Yuki Tsunoda will race for Racing Bulls in Zandvoort alongside Arvid Lindblad; Tsunoda is understood to be in talks for an IndyCar drive at Meyer Shank Racing in 2027.
